results.title: Caps → per-person demo limit
results.how: the room is a demo room (CK_DEMO_ROOMS), CK_DEMO_PER_PERSON_HOUR=3; one person posts 5 eligible cases one at a time
results.pass_when: the first 3 replied messages are answered; the next gets the limit line once; later ones get silence; each gated message is still seen
results.adapted: CK_CAPS (3 posts per room, a batched owner-desk note for the rest) no longer exists. The current design caps per person in public demo rooms (src/agent/demo.ts): one limit line, then silence, no owner note; so this checks that instead.
evidence: ok: L1: decided (reply A/covered), 1 reply post(s)
ok: L2: decided (reply A/parked), 1 reply post(s)
ok: L3: decided (reply A/covered), 1 reply post(s)
ok: L4: 0 decision line(s); thread "You've hit the demo limit for now — try again in a bit." (want the limit line once)
ok: L5: 0 decision line(s); thread silent (want silence)
ok: 2 message(s) arrived over the limit
ok: agent log: 1 "told once" and 1 "silent" demo_limit line(s): every gated message was seen and kept in the room's record, none dropped unseen

results.title: Caps → daily spend cap
results.how: the room is a demo room; CK_DAILY_SPEND_CAP_USD=0.001 (below one model call's cost); 3 messages from one person, the 2nd and 3rd after the cap note
results.pass_when: the owner desk gets the 80% note and the cap note once each; no model call is sent after the cap (the meter shows only the call that crossed it); the room gets the paused line once; later messages get silence. The first message's own call was sent before the cap, so its answer may post (spend.ts refuses only further calls); that is reported, not scored
results.adapted: CK_CAPS no longer exists; the spend cap (src/agent/spend.ts) is the current global limit, so this checks it alongside R7a.
evidence: ok: owner desk: 1 "Spend at 80%" and 1 "Daily spend cap reached" note(s)
ok: the agent's meter: 1 answered model call(s) under the cap (want 1: the call that crossed it)
ok: Q2, Q3 posted after the cap note; 0 of them reached the model
ok: Q2: "The demo has paused for today — back tomorrow." (want the paused line once)
Q1 (its call crossed the cap): not decided, 0 public post(s)

cost.note: Metered = the agent's own spend meter (every answered model call, priced by src/agent/model.ts); the trace figure misses calls that never reached a trace line (killed mid-flight, replaced prefetches, the cap-crossing call).
